centreline_definitions_mm.method: Derived from the midpoints of the visually associated A11/as-8 outer-member traces in the calibrated Section_A11_Axis_8 projection. The drawing traces determine member axis length; text location is not used as geometry.
centreline_definitions_mm.section_orientation: A11/as-8 is a YZ elevation at X=45950 mm. Nominal IPE flange width b is therefore placed along the out-of-plane X direction; section height h is placed in the elevation plane by the rigid member placement.

pending_before_solid_generation: No further geometry is approved beyond the six named members. Any additional member needs its own source mapping and authorisation.
